title: Bust Study
description: The use of oil paint to analyse hidden colours within light.

title: Marseille
description: A student artwork inspired by the atmosphere and character of Marseille.

title: Filtering The Future
medium: Acrylic and paper collage on canvas
description: Featuring collaged sustainable architecture research, this artwork depicts Singapore’s PARKROYAL building and its air-filtering roof gardens.

title: The Great Catch
description: A male hooded merganser tilts its beak up in victory as it catches a frog to eat after many efforts to scour for food in the murky water.

title: Time is (not) in your hands
description: Reflecting the inevitable passage of time, this piece illustrates hands across generations longing to be older or younger—bound to an unchangeable flow.

title: After Childhood
description: A graphite composition focusing on different materials-carved wooden joints, fabric folds, paper pages, and wooden blocks- to reflect the passing of time.

title: Blink Cat
description: An acrylic painting with thick, expressive brushstrokes depicting a textured orange tabby carrying a fish in its mouth against a dark blue backdrop.

title: Eye Cast Study
description: A pencil study focusing on form and shadow, carving out the contours of an eye embedded in a block of stone.

title: A Long Story
description: A detailed graphite portrait capturing subtle skin textures, deep-set wrinkles, and a quiet moment with a cigarette.
